row_unit: DANE municipality and origin month T
source_binding: Pinned Stage 2 execution manifest and construction contract; panel hash and schema must match
reference: H5: five exact prior years, same calendar month, no substitution
thresholds: P25/P75 for each target month from H5 observations at or before T; require all five
missingness: Preserve source zeros, nulls, coverage and per-variable valid days; no imputation
climate: Preserve all nine Stage 2 aggregates, units, signs and full-calendar-month coverage rule

roles.target: Existing y_t1 and y_t2, when present
roles.control: All remaining source metadata, target status/evaluability, source p75_t1/t2, historical traces and coverage
roles.metadata: Department code and validated municipality/department names, when present
roles.feature: Explicit allowlist: current counts, nine climate aggregates, current H5 channel, month of year, count lags, origin-safe H5 target-month thresholds

future_availability: Source p75_t1/t2 depend on future evaluability in Stage 2; always control. Independent p25_h5_t1/t2 and p75_h5_t1/t2 use history only
predictor_selection: Use predictor_matrix(table, schema); never infer X by dropping only target columns
publication: Single CSV plus contract, column dictionary, coverage, provenance and content-addressed manifest; atomic, no overwrite, no implicit latest
scope: Retrospective consolidated engineering only; no training, admission filters, splits or national ingestion
